Charged too much for valet service at the convention center.
Valet driver took my car to the wrong lot.
types.crew_needs: Location of the valet service, ticket number if available, and a description of the problem.

types.description: Resident asks about services they can receive by walking into a city office or facility.
phrasings: Do I need an appointment to get a parking permit?
Can I drop by the city hall for a building permit?
What services are available at the neighborhood office?
Is there a walk‑in window for driver’s license renewal?
types.crew_needs: Specific service the resident is interested in and the preferred office location.

types.description: Staff‑only high‑priority internal case where water has entered a gas line or appliance, requiring immediate safety inspection.
phrasings: Log: Water intrusion in gas line at apartment complex.
Internal: High‑priority gas‑water contamination report.
Staff note – emergency water in gas pipe, shut‑off needed.
Urgent: Water found in gas regulator, immediate response.
types.crew_needs: Exact address, description of the affected gas equipment, and any visible water presence.

types.description: Report of excessive noise from construction or other work occurring outside permitted hours.
phrasings: Construction is hammering at 10 p.m. on my block.
Loud drilling started early this morning before 7 a.m.
The crew is using a jackhammer late at night on the street.
Noise from a renovation is going on past the allowed time.
types.crew_needs: Address of the noisy site, type of work, and time the noise started.

types.description: Staff‑only internal work order for detecting or reporting work being done without the required city permit.
phrasings: INSPECTION: Unpermitted deck construction at 45 Oak St.
VIOLATION: No permit for fence installation on property.
REPORT: Illegal excavation observed on vacant lot.
COMPLAINT: Unapproved signage erected on storefront.
types.crew_needs: Address, description of the work, and any visible permit documentation (or lack thereof).

types.description: Staff‑only internal work order for building‑related tasks that must be performed outside normal hours.
phrasings: ISD_Building logged Working Beyond Hours for emergency roof repair.
DISP entry: Working Beyond Hours needed for after‑hours HVAC service.
SCH 5/12 Working Beyond Hours scheduled for night‑time window replacement.
Recorded Working Beyond Hours for 2 am plumbing fix in building 12.
types.crew_needs: Building address, specific task, and required access instructions for after‑hours work.

types.description: Internal zoning case logged by staff; residents do not submit this directly.
phrasings: Zoning review request entered by staff
Internal zoning compliance note
Crew logs zoning issue for property
Zoning case created by inspectional services
types.crew_needs: Staff must attach parcel ID and zoning district information.
